job.request: I need a professional website for a South African research consultancy.

brand.title: Karoo Research Advisory
brand.headline: Turn complex research into decisions people can actually use.
brand.subhead: A controlled Site Studio proof for a South African research consultancy, built from existing DIO positioning, semantic, document, evidence, presence and commercial-truth capabilities.

positioning.buyer_problem: Important research is often trapped in reports, disconnected evidence and unclear decision pathways.
positioning.desired_outcome: A credible public presence that makes expertise, services and evidence boundaries immediately understandable.

sections.title: Research strategy
sections.body: Frame complex questions, evidence needs and decision contexts without pretending uncertainty has disappeared.

sections.title: Evidence synthesis
sections.body: Turn supplied research and source material into reviewable, provenance-aware insight.

sections.title: Decision communication
sections.body: Translate governed meaning into clear reports, presentations and public-facing explanations.
